resources.string: Scan the code with the vigia CLI or use the address and token below. Reach the phone over Tailscale; other networks are blocked. Long-press the panel to come back here.
No network. Connect the phone to Wi-Fi or Tailscale.
Clients using the current token will stop working until you give them the new one.
Device owner: the panel is pinned and starts on boot.
Not device owner: the panel starts on boot as the home app. See docs/KIOSK.md for full kiosk mode.
No kiosk PIN set. Set one with: vigia secret set kiosk-pin
